scope: Carrollton-Farmers Branch ISD (CFB) school attendance polygons; display-only source provenance, not address assignment
findings: The district's official page says the public address finder reflects zones adopted on 2025-03-06.
The public school search embeds a GuideK12 SchoolSearch map (not an exportable school-geometry endpoint verified for this dashboard).
CFB's GIS contractor describes attendance zones as a GIS input, but no authenticated current per-campus GeoJSON/Shapefile download or ArcGIS feature service was established in this research.
NCES SABS published attendance-area geometry concerns the 2013–14 and 2015–16 cohorts, predating CFB's 2025 school consolidations, so it is unsuitable as current assignment geometry.
CFB Early College High School has a separate application and weighted lottery; it should not count as a routine missing neighborhood-attendance zone.

observedDashboardScope.sourceRecencyNote: Dashboard audit count is tied to the selected school's 2026 directory; re-evaluate with subsequent directory updates.

acceptanceCriteriaForFutureGeometry: Direct district-issued updated file or clearly public official live vector layer with geometry and per-school names
Explicit adoption date/version matching or postdating the March 2025 CFB consolidation
Elementary, middle, and high geometry coverage independently verified by official address samples and school names
Fail-closed for overlapping/missing geometry, school-program exceptions, or vintage ambiguity
Only then enable automatic selectable map boundary rendering for CFB
warning: Never derive a current school assignment from a 2015-16 SABS zone, a district-wide polygon, campus point locations, or visual georeferencing of screenshots.
